decision: Detect routing, exact-source, canonical-home, host-neutrality, shared-state preservation, compaction recovery, concurrency, and fidelity-readback failures in sync-change before release; this suite does not approve the skill.

scope.intended_use: Manually synchronizing one exact Pitch, Change Specification, Change Design, or implementation plan checkpoint with its canonical host-neutral work-item target without re-authoring, changing state, or expanding authority.
scope.case_source: Synthetic exact-artifact synchronization, missing-source and compacted-context refusal, stage-completion abstention, rough-source abstention, canonical-home, update-in-place state preservation, concurrency, harmless-normalization, unavailable-readback, inadequate-host, unsupported derived-record projection, authority, and routing-collision cases.
excluded_claims: Compatibility with untested hosts or models
Correctness of any real external service or connector

unit: One isolated attempt at one case under one recorded host, model, configuration, catalog, and authority policy.

environment.routing_boundary: Expose only catalog names and descriptions; select sync-change only when an exact complete landed artifact and explicit persistence intent are both present, otherwise abstain without side effects.
environment.execution_boundary: Activate the target in a disposable task-local workspace with synthetic public artifacts and host observations; perform no real external mutation.

evidence.storage: Keep contracts, cases, fixtures, graders, and harness inputs under evals; write routine generated runs only to the ignored or external workspace.

grading.instrument: Deterministic routing and forbidden-effect checks plus assertion-based review of exact-source preservation, canonical ownership, state, authority, concurrency, persisted readback, fidelity, and compaction boundaries.
grading.unknown_policy: Unavailable target, source, host capability, readback, harness, output, or side-effect evidence produces unknown rather than pass.
critical_gates: Synchronization binds complete exact source rather than reconstructing it
One canonical artifact home remains identifiable
Artifact meaning, state, and authority are not changed
Compaction never licenses reconstruction of lost chat-only edits
Concurrent edits are preserved or surfaced before overwrite
Claimed persistence is grounded in authoritative readback
Fidelity distinguishes VERIFIED-EXACT, VERIFIED-FAITHFUL, DRIFT, and UNVERIFIED outcomes
Derived implementation-record projection remains outside synchronization
Routing and execution claims remain distinct
grading.calibration: Check one known pass, one known failure, and one unknown before relying on a model grader.

trials.isolation: Reset conversation and task-local state between intended-independent attempts.
trials.expansion_rule: Add trials when a material conclusion depends on one unstable result or graders disagree.

comparison.baseline: The same target system without sync-change for new capability cases, and the previous accepted exact revision for later revisions, under otherwise identical conditions.
comparison.absence: Record no-baseline rather than inferring improvement.

analysis.aggregation_rule: Keep routing, execution, critical gates, unknowns, partial effects, and harness failures visible before aggregation.
analysis.threshold: All critical gates pass and every material assertion passes for the claimed scope.

critical_assertions.assertion: The response uses only the prompt-supplied synthetic host's declared native semantics and introduces no vendor-specific fields, labels, workflows, or assumptions.

critical_assertions.gate: Synchronization binds complete exact source rather than reconstructing it
critical_assertions.assertion: The response stops before mutation because a summary is not the exact artifact source.

critical_assertions.gate: One canonical artifact home remains identifiable
critical_assertions.assertion: The inadequate host receives only a linked synopsis while the complete artifact remains canonical in its exact source.

critical_assertions.gate: Artifact meaning, state, and authority are not changed
critical_assertions.assertion: The Draft Specification remains Draft and no host state or polished presentation is treated as acceptance.
Only the authorized body and revision binding change; title, labels, workflow, priority, assignment, and relationships remain unchanged.

critical_assertions.gate: Concurrent edits are preserved or surfaced before overwrite
critical_assertions.assertion: The response stops before overwriting the concurrently changed canonical artifact location.

critical_assertions.gate: Claimed persistence is grounded in authoritative readback
critical_assertions.assertion: Unavailable readback produces UNVERIFIED rather than a success claim.

critical_assertions.gate: Fidelity distinguishes VERIFIED-EXACT, VERIFIED-FAITHFUL, DRIFT, and UNVERIFIED outcomes
critical_assertions.assertion: Documented harmless representation normalization is reported as VERIFIED-FAITHFUL rather than DRIFT or byte-exact identity.

critical_assertions.gate: Derived implementation-record projection remains outside synchronization
critical_assertions.assertion: Derived implementation-record creation is identified as outside sync-change.

critical_assertions.gate: Compaction never licenses reconstruction of lost chat-only edits
critical_assertions.assertion: No chat-only content, Ready state, resolved open item, or revision identity is invented after compaction.

critical_assertions.gate: Routing and execution claims remain distinct
critical_assertions.assertion: Sync-change is not selected because no exact landed artifact exists.

provenance.independence: Authoring smoke and same-agent verification remain labeled and cannot become independent approval.

refresh_triggers: Skill, description, resource, package-boundary, host-support, authority, or side-effect changes
Case, grader, harness, support-path, or evidence-lifecycle changes
Host, model, catalog, or intended-cohort changes
Confirmed routing, fidelity, mutation, or projection failure

estimand.sampling_unit: One case, configuration, and stochastic trial.
estimand.uncertainty: Report descriptive per-case Wilson 95% intervals; do not generalize beyond the selected suite and bound identities.

lifecycle.preflight_failure: Reserved disposition with no evidence directory.
lifecycle.retry: Append a new attempt without overwriting prior evidence.
lifecycle.resume: Resume only after every material source, target, host, runner, adapter, and authority identity matches.
